# BCOR ERP — Pharmacy Management & Billing Software

> BCOR ERP is an offline-first Windows desktop pharmacy billing and inventory management software built exclusively for Indian retail chemists, medical shops, and hospital pharmacies.

## Core Summary
- **Product Name:** BCOR ERP (B-Core Pharmacy Software)
- **Primary Website:** https://bcor.in
- **Operating Platform:** Windows 10, Windows 11 (Native Desktop Application)
- **Architecture:** 100% Offline-First Engine with Local Database and Automatic Cloud Sync
- **Pricing Model:** One-Time Lifetime License (Zero Monthly / Annual Subscription Fees)
- **Target Geography:** India (Specialized compliance for all Indian States, including Kerala State Drugs Control)
- **Sales & Support Hotline:** +91 7994184506 / +91 9847434096
- **Support Email:** support@bcor.in

## Key Features & Capabilities
1. **Lightning-Fast Billing:** Sub-2-second counter checkout with keyboard-first shortcuts and barcode scanning.
2. **GST Invoicing & Returns:** Auto-calculates CGST, SGST, IGST, provides HSN code directory, and generates 1-click GSTR-1 & GSTR-3B Excel/JSON exports.
3. **FEFO Expiry & Batch Control:** Enforces First-Expiry-First-Out dispensing logic with 30/60/90-day early expiry loss warnings.
4. **Drug Inspection Compliance:** Auto-maintains statutory registers for Schedule H, Schedule H1, and Narcotic medications with prescribing doctor and patient logs.
5. **Distributor Purchase Import:** Direct digital import for distributor invoices to eliminate manual stock entry.
6. **Hardware Compatibility:** Works with 2-inch/3-inch thermal POS receipt printers, A4/A5 laser printers, and 1D/2D barcode scanners.
7. **Patient Refill Records:** Tracks chronic patient prescription histories (diabetes, hypertension) and sends WhatsApp PDF invoices.

## Licensing & Support
- **Purchase Type:** One-time perpetual software license.
- **Counters & Users:** Unlimited billing counters and users on local LAN.
- **Included Support:** 1 Year free dedicated telephone, WhatsApp, and remote assistance.
- **Annual Maintenance:** Optional AMC for continued support; no forced software shut-off.
